name: Lord Serpentis
summary: Lord Serpentis is a corrupted night elf druid who stands as one of the four leaders of the rogue Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once a druid of great power and prestige in the order of Naralex, he was twisted into madness when Naralex's dream became a nightmare within the subterranean springs. Now, he helps command the serpent-worshipping sect deep in the caverns where the corrupted Naralex lies slumbering.

sections.title: From Noble Druid to Serpent Lord
sections.body: Before darkness overtook the cavern springs, Serpentis was a druid of great power and prestige, one of the noble order led by Naralex that hoped to use the caverns' springs and the Emerald Dream to heal the Barrens. However, when Naralex's vision became a corrupting nightmare, Serpentis was among the druids whose minds fell to the emerging madness.

sections.title: A Lord of the Fang
sections.body: Succumbing completely to the corruption radiating from Naralex's twisted dreams, Serpentis and his fellow druids became the Druids of the Fang. Forsaking traditional Cenarion balance and the totem animals of old, they now seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams rather than heal it. Serpentis rules the sect as one of its four leaders, alongside Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn and Lord Pythas.

sections.title: The Final Obstacle
sections.body: Perched deep inside the winding caverns, Lord Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the rogue sect, each of whom carries a dream gem. Those seeking to wake the trapped master or reclaim the waters of the Oasis must strike down Serpentis and claim the gem he carries, breaking the serpent's hold over the labyrinth.

faq.answer: Lord Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang, located deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf druid of great power and prestige in Naralex's order, he was corrupted by Naralex's nightmare along with his fellow druids.

When Naralex's attempt to heal the Barrens through the Emerald Dream turned into a nightmare, its corruption spread to the druids who followed him, turning Serpentis's mind toward madness and serpent worship.

faq.q: What is his relationship to Naralex?
faq.answer: Serpentis was once one of the noble druids who followed Naralex into the caverns. Rather than aiding in his master's recovery, he became a leader of the Druids of the Fang, who now seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams.

faq.q: Why do players need to kill him?
faq.answer: Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang. Eliminating him is essential to break the sect's grip on the Wailing Caverns, secure his gem for the quest Leaders of the Fang, and clear a path toward awakening Naralex.

faq.q: Who are the Druids of the Fang?
aliases: what are druids of the fang
faq.answer: They are a renegade faction of night elf druids who followed Naralex into the Wailing Caverns. Corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare, they abandoned traditional druidic forms to adopt the aspects, venoms, and behaviors of serpents under the command of Serpentis and their other fanglords.

angles.text: Serpentis represents the tragic danger lurking within the Emerald Dream, showcasing how even a druid of great power can be twisted when a noble vision becomes a nightmare.
For night elves, Serpentis and his followers are a painful disgrace—kaldorei scholars of great renown who threw away their sacred duty to nature to become monstrous serpent lords.
Tauren see the corruption of Serpentis as a foul desecration of the Earth Mother's balance, threatening the fragile ecosystem of the Barrens with unnatural madness.
